family.description: This family of archaebacterial proteins are holliday junction resolvases (hjc gene) [[cite:PUB00007198]]. The Holliday junction is an essential intermediate of homologous recombination. This protein is the archaeal equivalent of RuvC but is not sequence similar.
family.name: Archaeal holliday junction resolvase (hjc)

history.description: Nine scoped graphs retain sixteen observed effects from inspected 1999,2000 and2019 primary methods/results and original figures. Reference sequences and domain coordinates are verified; T138 lies outside the SiRe Pfam match. Distinguish purified processing from extract depletion and cellular spot outgrowth, and mutation-dependent labeling from direct phosphosite localization. Retain supplementary-access gaps, unverified2019 primers and other family contexts; status IN_PROGRESS. No publication or whole-family completion claim.
history.summary: Curate Hjc junction processing, biochemical controls and substitution-specific readouts.

history.description: Saved same-agent review of the exact projection digest54f6a5cedb7a6928adcddb82d351704d92283158e2e9ea7ac68f1971c26c8a21. Sixteen observed edges retain thirteen direct preparation-level and three indirect extract/cellular effects. Sequence and Pfam mapping, original figures and reaction conditions checked. Unretrieved2019 supplements and primers, unresolved Figure2 kinase dose, Pfu mutagenesis and Hje contexts remain open. Review is NEEDS_FOLLOWUP and IN_PROGRESS remains unchanged; no independent endorsement or publication.
history.summary: Retain partial scientific review of Hjc causal contexts.

causal_graphs.context: 10 nM Hjc and10 nM substrate,10 mM Tris pH8.8,10 mM MgCl2,200 mM KCl,1 mM DTT,56 C1 h; denaturing PAGE with strand-specific labels.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure4A-D, substrate and endonuclease Methods; source mapping distinguishes mobile from immobile substrates and does not add an unobserved ligation step.

edges.mechanism: Protein-containing reactions yield mapped cleavage products absent from matched no-protein lanes; the major sites are symmetrical on opposing strands, with additional minor sites retained.
edges.subject: hjc-reaction

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Pfu PF1503,E7FHX4 sequence version1,123 aa,equals BAA82839.1 from AB023635.1 and WP_011012650.1; PF01870 1-97. Untagged pPFHJ2/pET21a preparation, not an isolated domain.
causal_graphs.limitations: Predominant opposing strand2/4 cuts coexist with minor cuts. Other DNA structures can be weak substrates, especially at higher enzyme doses. No family-wide exclusivity or cellular repair claim.

nodes.label: Add purified Pfu Hjc to a Mg-containing four-way junction reaction

causal_graphs.scope: Komori1999 Figure4, immobile4J and mobile4Jh in separate reactions.
causal_graphs.title: Purified Pfu Hjc cleaves synthetic four-way DNA junctions

causal_graphs.context: RecA2.7 uM with gapped pUC1186 uM nucleotides and labeled linear DNA3 uM nucleotides; strand exchange37 C20 min after5 min preincubation. Hjc0-50 nM then55 C10 min; agarose analysis after deproteinization.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure5B dose labels and RecA-minus/Hjc-minus controls; the readout is intermediate processing, not independent Hjc strand-exchange activity.

edges.mechanism: Increasing Hjc from0 through1,2.5,5,10 and50 nM reduces the intermediate band under the fixed post-exchange protocol.
edges.subject: add-hjc

evidence.explanation: Figure5A product interpretation and original Figure5B gel; no Hjc-dependent RecA activation or matched RuvC superiority is asserted.

edges.mechanism: The same Hjc titration increases product bands assigned as linear dimers and nicked circles, alongside depletion of the intermediates. The two measured endpoints do not prove an unobserved microscopic sequence.
edges.subject: add-hjc

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Pfu PF1503,E7FHX4/WP_011012650.1,PF01870 1-97. The RecA component is bacterial; this is a mixed-species reconstitution, not a Pfu cellular pathway.
causal_graphs.limitations: Resolved product classes are assigned by the source's gel interpretation. RuvC control uses37 C1 h and cannot provide a matched rate comparison. No elementary reaction rate or intracellular repair measurement.

nodes.label: Increase Hjc dose after RecA intermediate formation

causal_graphs.scope: Komori1999 Figure5, purified Hjc added after E.coli RecA strand exchange.
causal_graphs.title: Pfu Hjc resolves RecA-generated DNA intermediates in vitro

causal_graphs.context: Antibody treatment at room temperature;4 ul treated extract with10 nM junction in standard cleavage buffer,56 C30 min. Anti-PCNA and anti-PI-PfuI comparison antibodies; immunoprecipitate Western blot.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure3C cleavage lanes and immunoprecipitate blot with Methods; antibody controls and lack of re-addition define the causal scope.

edges.mechanism: Anti-Hjc treatment lowers cleavage relative to untreated and comparison-antibody extracts. Hjc is present in the precipitate, but possible loss of partners prevents an individually isolated molecular attribution.
edges.subject: anti-hjc

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Endogenous Pfu Hjc assigned to PF1503/E7FHX4,PF01870 1-97,via the original cloned gene and antibody experiment. Whole extract, not purified domain.
causal_graphs.limitations: Cell-free extract endpoint, not a cellular knockout. Co-depletion remains possible and no add-back rescue is shown. Anti-PCNA co-precipitation is association evidence, not a PCNA activation edge.

nodes.label: Deplete crude extract with anti-Hjc antibody

causal_graphs.scope: Komori1999 Figure3, crude Pfu extract immunodepletion.
causal_graphs.title: Anti-Hjc depletion reduces extract junction cleavage

causal_graphs.context: 10 nM asymmetric4Jhs with1 uM Hjc,56 C1 h; phenol extraction and ethanol precipitation; then T4 ligase at16 C2 h with ATP and Mg. Starting labeled strand59 nt, cleavage product37 nt, ligation product70 nt.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure3A-B and ligation Methods distinguish sequential cleavage, deproteinization and ligase addition.

edges.mechanism: A70-nt band matching the marker appears after ligase treatment of the recovered digestion products and is absent from the no-ligase digest lane.
edges.subject: ligase-and-cleaved-dna

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Same Pfu Hjc preparation method as1999,E7FHX4/WP_011012650.1,PF01870 1-97. T4 ligase is an added enzyme, not an activity assigned to the Hjc domain.
causal_graphs.limitations: Ligase unit dose is not specified. This establishes end compatibility under the supplied reaction, not completed intracellular recombination or Hjc-catalyzed ligation.

nodes.label: Add T4 ligase to recovered Hjc-cleaved DNA in ligase buffer

causal_graphs.scope: Komori2000 Figure3, ligation after deproteinized Hjc digestion.
causal_graphs.title: T4 ligase joins Hjc cleavage products

causal_graphs.context: 10 nM Hjc,100 nM4Jh,56 C30 min;10 mM Tris pH8.8,200 mM KCl,1 mM DTT,variable added MgCl2. Product readout by gel electrophoresis.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure4B and reaction-condition Methods/Results distinguish added-metal effects from the other necessary reaction components.

edges.mechanism: Cleavage product increases relative to zero added MgCl2, with maximal signal around5-10 mM in the source titration. Mg is a conditional co-input with Hjc and DNA, not an independently sufficient cause.
edges.subject: add-magnesium

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Pfu E7FHX4/WP_011012650.1,123 aa,PF01870 1-97. Intact enzyme preparation with DNA, not isolated domain or metal alone.
causal_graphs.limitations: Added-metal dependence does not identify metal ligands or prove a unique physiological cofactor. Mn supports lesser activity in a separate panel; zinc salt is inconsistent between text and figure. Temperature effects are not automatically enzyme denaturation.

nodes.label: Add5-10 mM MgCl2 to the otherwise complete Hjc-junction reaction

causal_graphs.scope: Komori2000 Figure4B, MgCl2 titration in the specified reconstitution.
causal_graphs.title: Added magnesium supports Pfu Hjc cleavage

causal_graphs.context: 10 nM labeled4Jb,100 nM Hjc,0.1-1 uM unlabeled competitor,20 mM Tris-acetate pH8,1 mM DTT,0.1 mg/ml BSA,5% glycerol,ice10 min; no added Mg,6% native PAGE in TGE with2 mM EDTA.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure5A HJ-versus-duplex competition lanes and binding Methods, separate from Figure5B enzyme titration and the cleavage experiments.

edges.mechanism: Unlabeled four-way junction reduces labeled shifted-complex signal across the competitor titration, unlike matched linear duplex competitor. No arrow from complex occupancy to catalysis is inferred.
edges.subject: competitor-junction

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Pfu E7FHX4/WP_011012650.1,PF01870 1-97; intact protein and synthetic DNA, not an isolated-domain binding measurement.
causal_graphs.limitations: Binding is measured without cleavage conditions. Linear Db2 competitor does not have the same effect. A separate enzyme titration's apparent Kd is not a catalytic rate or proof that binding activates cleavage.

nodes.label: Increase unlabeled4Jb competitor in the Hjc binding reaction

causal_graphs.title: Unlabeled junction competes for Pfu Hjc binding

causal_graphs.context: 5 uM tag-free Hjc or variant,65 C30 min,25 mM Tris pH8,10 mM NaCl,5 mM MgCl2,2 mM DTT,50 uM ATP plus8.3 nM gamma-32P ATP; SDS-PAGE autoradiography. Methods allow1 or2 uM kinase; Figure2 dose is not independently resolved.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure2A SiRe_0171 panel and relative-signal bars; three independent experiments with SD are reported. SupplementS3 is not treated as independently inspected evidence.

edges.mechanism: S34A reduces Hjc-associated radiolabel relative to WT in the matched kinase reaction. This supports a residue-dependent phosphorylation readout, without directly observing a uniquely occupied S34 phosphosite.
edges.subject: s34a-0171

evidence.explanation: Original Figure2A SiRe_2030 S9A lane and normalized bars; no transfer to SiRe_0171 or SiRe_2056KD is made.

edges.mechanism: S9A reduces the Hjc band signal with SiRe_2030 while substantial labeling persists. The source's site assignment is supported indirectly by substitution, not a measured site-specific phosphate bond.
edges.subject: s9a-2030

evidence.explanation: Original Figure2B SiRe_2030 single-mutant lanes and bars, not the double-mutant-only comparison in Figure2A.

edges.mechanism: T138A lowers labeling compared with WT in the SiRe_2030 reaction; the single-mutant comparison distinguishes it from the S136A/T138A double mutant. T138 is outside the mapped Pfam domain.
edges.subject: t138a-2030

evidence.explanation: Original Figure2B SiRe_2056KD panel and matched normalized bars; the result is not assigned to full-length SiRe_2056 in vivo.

edges.mechanism: T138A reduces Hjc labeling with the SiRe_2056 kinase-domain preparation. Residual signal and the weaker S136A effect preclude a unique-site or complete-ablation claim.
edges.subject: t138a-2056kd

causal_graphs.family_mapping: SiRe_1431,F0NID3 sequence version1,143 aa,equals WP_012711550.1; PF01870 4-134. S9/S34 are inside; T138 is outside PF01870. Untagged pET15bM preparation; supplementary primers not verified.
causal_graphs.limitations: Mutation-dependent radiolabeling is not direct phosphosite localization or in vivo occupancy. Residual labeling remains. SiRe_2056KD is a kinase-domain construct. Similar gel-filtration elution does not prove identical folding.

nodes.label: Substitute Hjc S34A in the SiRe_0171 reaction
Substitute Hjc S9A in the SiRe_2030 reaction
Substitute Hjc T138A in the SiRe_2030 reaction
Substitute Hjc T138A in the SiRe_2056KD reaction

causal_graphs.scope: Huang2019 Figure2, each substitution and kinase tested separately.
causal_graphs.title: Hjc substitutions lower kinase-specific labeling readouts

causal_graphs.context: 10 nM tag-free Hjc or each variant,1 nM labeled junction,25 mM Tris pH8,25 mM NaCl,5 mM MgCl2,1 mM DTT,0.01% BSA,65 C30 min; denaturing PAGE after formamide-EDTA stop and boiling.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure3 S9E gel lane and quantified bar, matched WT and no-protein controls, cleavage Methods.
evidence.snippet: HJ DNA Cleavage Assay of Hjc

edges.mechanism: S9E yields about20% cleavage compared with roughly70% for WT in the displayed endpoint assay. Residual activity remains; no exact kinetic fold-change or true-phosphorylation effect is assigned.
edges.subject: s9e

evidence.explanation: Original Figure3 S34E and S34A lanes/bars; supplementS5 kinase-treated cleavage is not substituted for the directly inspected mutant experiment.
evidence.snippet: HJ DNA Cleavage Assay of Hjc

edges.mechanism: S34E lowers cleavage to near the detection floor under this protocol, while the S34A comparison retains substantial activity. No observed Mg-coordination disruption is inferred from the homology model.
edges.subject: s34e

evidence.explanation: Original Figure3 D42N lane and nonzero low bar; retain the measured endpoint rather than declaring universal complete inactivity.
evidence.snippet: HJ DNA Cleavage Assay of Hjc

edges.mechanism: The D42N control has very little cleavage compared with WT. This is a measured substitution effect, not direct visualization of metal coordination, proton transfer or the catalytic transition state.
edges.subject: d42n

causal_graphs.family_mapping: SiRe_1431,F0NID3/WP_012711550.1,PF01870 4-134. S9,S34,D42 are inside the match; whole proteins were expressed and purified, not isolated domains.
causal_graphs.limitations: S9E and S34E are phosphomimetic substitutions, not verified phosphoserine. Endpoint fraction is not a kinetic constant. WT-like T138A/E and retained S9A/S34A activity limit generalization; exact folding equivalence is unproved.

nodes.label: Junction substrate fraction cleaved after30 min

causal_graphs.scope: Huang2019 Figure3, three separate mutant-versus-WT contrasts.
causal_graphs.title: Hjc S9E S34E and D42N reduce purified junction cleavage

causal_graphs.context: REY15A delta-pyrEF delta-lacS host with hjc allele replacement; early-log OD6000.2-0.3,tenfold dilutions,10 ul spots,75 C7-10 days. Compare25 J/m2 UV and15 ug/ml cisplatin separately.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure5B UV panels and damage-sensitivity Methods; lower-dose and untreated comparisons constrain the phenotype.

edges.mechanism: The S34E replacement strain shows greater spot outgrowth than the matched Hjc control at25 J/m2 UV. The intervening repair/fork processes are not directly measured.
edges.subject: s34e-uv

evidence.explanation: Original Figure5B cisplatin panels and Methods; MMS/HU comparisons in Figure5A limit the phenotype. No kinase-to-Hjc epistasis experiment is inferred.

edges.mechanism: Greater spot outgrowth occurs at15 ug/ml cisplatin, not at the lower tested dose. This conditional phenotype does not establish enhanced repair as the directly observed endpoint or universal damage resistance.
edges.subject: s34e-cisplatin

causal_graphs.family_mapping: SiRe_1431,F0NID3/WP_012711550.1,PF01870 4-134; S34 is within the match. Whole-cell allele effect with Hje intact, not isolated-domain chemistry or unmodified wild-type REY15A.
causal_graphs.limitations: Spot outgrowth is not direct repair kinetics or a quantitative growth-rate measurement. No apparent benefit at15 J/m2 UV or10 ug/ml cisplatin, nor MMS/HU. Methods report at least3 trials; caption says2-3. Do not merge delta-hje or kinase-knockout experiments.

nodes.label: Replace chromosomal Hjc with S34E under25 J/m2 UV
Replace chromosomal Hjc with S34E under15 ug/ml cisplatin

causal_graphs.scope: Huang2019 Figure5B, E233S with Hje intact, two distinct damaging treatments.
causal_graphs.title: Chromosomal Hjc S34E improves high-dose damage spot outgrowth

record.description: This family of archaebacterial proteins are holliday junction resolvases (hjc gene) [[cite:PUB00007198]]. The Holliday junction is an essential intermediate of homologous recombination. This protein is the archaeal equivalent of RuvC but is not sequence similar.

evidence.explanation: Figures2/3/5 were inspected; supplementS1-S9 and TablesS1/S2 need direct inspection. Homology-model Mg interference and proposed repair-pathway switching are not observed causal steps.

discussions.notes: See evidence/PF01870/hjc-identity.txt and hjc-gap-ledger.txt. Retrieve primers and kinase-dead/binding/kinase-treated-cleavage controls, verify exact construct scope, and distinguish true site-specific phosphorylation from Glu substitutions. No Hjc-specific epistasis or direct repair-kinetics claim.
discussions.prompt: Verify supplementary constructs and controls before extending phosphorylation mechanisms.
discussions.rationale: Mutation-dependent labeling, phosphomimetic cleavage and cellular spot outgrowth are distinct endpoints. S136/T138 are outside the current PF01870 match4-134; primary supplementary files were not retrieved as valid source payloads.

evidence.explanation: Substrate geometry, MBP/proteolysis and additional biochemical contexts remain uncurated. A single activity peak is not proof that another nuclease is absent.

discussions.notes: Review PMID11005813 full mutagenesis methods/figures and PMID15479781 Hje with exact sequences before adding edges. The former publisher PDF returned403; an abstract is not completed primary review. Preserve IN_PROGRESS and partial same-agent review.
discussions.prompt: Extend primary causal review to Pfu residue studies and Hje members.
discussions.rationale: Nine graphs cover two Hjc preparations and selected protocols, not all744 frozen family proteins or the additional Hje resolvases. Weak non-HJ cleavage also limits substrate exclusivity.
